decisions.reason: The aloe vera line builds directly on the firm's core natural-formulation know-how and has had its own page for two years, so the firm can read its results well and keep refining it in-house.
A hyaluronic serum fits the firm's existing facial care competence and has stayed listed for two years, so the firm can absorb customer feedback and improve it without outside knowledge.

The cleansing oil is newly launched and close to the firm's oil-based formulation expertise, and it may be replacing the dropped cleansing milk, so the firm will likely give it time while early results come in, though its short track record makes it somewhat less certain.
